admission.justification: Unit tests verify strict exact-key deserialization, non-boolean type validation and timestamp-free canonical JSON, preventing silent schema drift or nondeterministic diffs in downstream validators and site banners.

applicability: All Phase 0 audit domain dataclasses and canonical JSON serialization under src/rh_pipeline/models/audit.py.
conditions: Every dataclass is frozen with slots, wraps mapping fields in sorted read-only views, and validates exact key sets and field types in from_dict.
VerificationStatus restricts build_status to 'unverified-locally' and format_canonical_json emits sorted-key indent=2 JSON with a trailing newline.
exclusions: Cross-field consistency between VerificationStatus top-level counts and its nested scan summary is enforced by build_verification_status rather than from_dict.
statement: Phase 0 audit domain models are immutable frozen dataclasses with strict exact-key to_dict/from_dict validation and deterministic sorted-key canonical JSON formatting without wall-clock timestamps.
title: Immutable Phase 0 audit models and timestamp-free canonical JSON
